module: Red Hat Enterprise Linux 8 GnuTLS Cryptographic Module
caveat: When operated in FIPS mode. The module generates cryptographic keys whose strengths are modified by available entropy.
description: GnuTLS is a secure communications library implementing the TLS and DTLS protocols. It provides a simple C language application programming interface to access the secure communications protocols as well as APIs to parse and write X.509, PCKS#12, and other required structures which is shipped with Red Hat Enterprise Linux 7.6.
tested_configurations: Red Hat Enterprise Linux 8 running on Dell PowerEdge R430 with an Intel(R) Xeon(R) E5 with PAA
Red Hat Enterprise Linux 8 running on Dell PowerEdge R430 with an Intel(R) Xeon(R) E5 without PAA (single-user mode)
allowed_algorithms: Diffie-Hellman (Cert. #A120, key agreement; key establishment methodology provides between 112 and 256 bits of encryption strength); EC Diffie-Hellman (Cert. #A120, key agreement; key establishment methodology provides between 128 and 256 bits of encryption strength); MD5; NDRNG; RSA (key wrapping; key establishment methodology provides between 112 and 256 bits of encryption strength);
